A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''Imperial Advisor''' was one of only a few hundred of the [[Imperial Advisor/Legends|Advisors]] who were genuinely loyal to [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[New Order/Legends|New Order]], and the individual was therefore appointed as a member of the [[Imperial Ruling Council/Legends|Imperial Ruling Council]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the [[Advisor/Legends|Advisor]] was one of six who accompanied the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] to the [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star II]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]] shortly before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], in which all were [[Death/Legends|killed]] when the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] was attacked and destroyed by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].

==Biography==
[[File:EmperorsArrival-SWHC10.png|thumb|left|260px|Emperor Palpatine and his six Advisors arrive aboard the second Death Star.]]
A [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="Return of the Jedi" /> [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="mistaken identity" /> served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]<ref name="Return of the Jedi" /> as an [[Imperial Advisor/Legends|Imperial Advisor]]<ref name="Starships" /> during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] against the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="Return of the Jedi" /> For being one of the few hundred [[Advisor/Legends|Advisors]] who were genuinely loyal to [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and his [[New Order/Legends|New Order]], the Advisor was appointed to the [[Imperial Ruling Council/Legends|Imperial Ruling Council]], which was also known as the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor's]] Inner Circle. The Imperial Ruling Council was based on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]],<ref name="Starships" /> and its members were allowed private audiences with the Emperor.<ref name="Barbarian" /> While Palpatine ruled the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]], the Advisors managed the Empire and carried out the Emperor's will.<ref name="Character Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

The Imperial Advisors' duties consisted of overseeing both their home [[Star system/Legends|systems]] and those of rival Advisors as well as administrative duties that included appointing Imperial [[Governor/Legends|governors]] and [[Moff/Legends|Moffs]].<ref name="Character Encyclopedia" /> In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="Galactic Files" /> the red-and-black-[[Robe/Legends|robed]] Advisor was one of six Advisors who accompanied Emperor Palpatine to the Imperial [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star II]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]], in construction over the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]]. The group arrived aboard the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] in Palpatine's [[Emperor's personal shuttle/Legends|private shuttle]] and landed in one of the Death Star's [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] bays, where they were greeted by an assembly of Imperial personnel and by Palpatine's [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]. The Advisors accompanied Palpatine and Vader as the pair departed the hangar. A short time later, the Death Star was attacked by the Alliance during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]],<ref name="Return of the Jedi" /> and all six of the Emperor's Advisors were [[Death/Legends|killed]] in the [[Space station/Legends|station's]] destruction.<ref name="Galactic Files" />

==Personality and traits==
The red-and-black-robed Advisor's position in the Imperial Ruling Council was a testament to the individual's loyalty to Palpatine and the New Order.<ref name="Starships" /> The Advisor had pale skin and brown [[Hair/Legends|eyebrows]].<ref name="Barbarian" />

==Equipment==
Imperial Advisors wore lavish robes as an indication of their status,<ref name="Character Encyclopedia" /> and the Advisor wore a robe that was red and black in [[Color/Legends|color]].<ref name="Return of the Jedi" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:ImperialAdvisors.png|thumb|right|250px|The Emperor's Advisors]]
{{Quote|The Emperor's Inner Circle, or Palpatine's creepy advisors, depending on your point-of-view....|Keeper of the [[Holocron continuity database|Holocron]] [[Leland Chee]]|<ref name="Barbarian" />}}
The Emperor's Advisors were first referenced, as "the Emperor's courtiers," in [[James Kahn]]'s [[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (novelization)|novelization]] of the [[1983]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']]<ref name="ROTJ novel">[[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi'' novelization]]</ref> before appearing in the film itself later the same year.<ref name="Return of the Jedi" /> The Imperial Advisors' outfits were designed by [[Nilo Rodis-Jamero]], who was inspired by the outfits of [[Wikipedia:Catholic Church|Catholic]] [[Wikipedia:Bishop|bishops]].<ref name="Annotated Screenplays">''[[Star Wars: The Annotated Screenplays]]''</ref>

In [[2003]], a ''Return of the Jedi'' production photo of the red-and-black-robed Advisor and four of the five others was included in a [[StarWars.com]] [https://web.archive.org/web/20031008010828/www.starwars.com/community/askjc/jocasta/askjc20030602.html article], with text that read, "Among the members of Palpatine's Inner Circle are: [[Sate Pestage/Legends|Sate Pestage]], [[Janus Greejatus/Legends|Janus Greejatus]], [[Sim Aloo/Legends|Sim Aloo]], [[Ars Dangor/Legends|Ars Dangor]], and [[Kren Blista-Vanee/Legends|Kren Blista-Vanee]]."<ref name="mistaken identity" /> This led to certain fan confusion, in which the red-and-black-robed Advisor was interpreted to be Sate Pestage,<ref name="confusion">{{Blog|teekay-421|66|Deciphering CCG Imperials on Death Star II}}</ref> given that Pestage had previously been identified in the [[Star Wars Legends|Expanded Universe]] wearing a similar headpiece.<ref name="NEGTC">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> However, the [[2013]] ''[[2013 Topps Star Wars Galactic Files Series 2]]'' card set reveals that all six Advisors aboard the Death Star were killed during the Battle of Endor,<ref name="Galactic Files" /> while Pestage is established to have lived past the Battle of Endor, thus eliminating any connection between the two characters.<ref name="CSWE Pestage entry">{{CSWECite|III|21&ndash;22|Pestage, Sate}}</ref> In the new ''Star Wars'' [[canon]], author [[Jason Fry]] identified the advisor as Sate Pestage, as Pestage's history post-Endor was not part of the new continuity.<ref name="Twitter">{{Twitter|jasoncfry|status/1697627240442532052|[[Jason Fry]]|date=2023-09-01|quote=This is correct!|archivedate=20230907031658|archivefile=File:Pestage_Twitter.png}} {{C|In response to: "Could you possibly tell us which one you meant to be Pestage (and therefore which one you meant to be Xorn)? My assumption is Pestage is on the left."}}</ref>
